description: Wikidata identifiers of the company: Q-id, entity URL, ticker and inception date (CC0 subset only; no labels, logos or websites). Useful to link the company to other datasets. May answer 503 when the integrations projection is offline.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

name: borme_get_company_wikidata
